entities.name: W-AGF acting on behalf of N5GC device

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the N5GC indication IE when the condition is met.
Presence of N5GC indication IE is guarded by the condition that W-AGF is acting on behalf of an N5GC device.
